'''2008 Match Play Championship Day 1 David Runyon DS Ralltiir Operations''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[David Runyon]] at [[2008 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Ralltiir Operations / In The Hands Of The Empire|SE-D-ralltiiroperations.gif}}
